0425c8df31d0ba43e6b34cead18ad02f0cf7de56.summary: Malpedia family page for StoneDrill, a malware family. The page lists Charming Kitten as its actor and gives no description. Its references are reports from Kaspersky Labs (2017), Symantec (2018 and 2019), PwC UK (2020 and 2021) and CrowdStrike (2022). The Kaspersky title links StoneDrill to Shamoon and to wiper attacks on Saudi organizations. The page notes that no YARA signature exists yet.
